description: A candlelit vigil with inertial windbreaks and moving flower offerings. Each completed control advances the vigil by 0.4 seconds; waiting leaves the visible state stable.
name: Funeral Ritual V2 · Difficulty 3 · Full Interaction
natural_language: Uncover the memorial, light the candles, protect their flames against changing drafts for thirty seconds, and lay the flowers in the stone’s order. Move each windbreak across its draft; its ribbon shows the current crossing and the next two seconds. Shields have inertia. Waiting leaves the visible state stable; each accepted control advances the vigil by 0.4 seconds. A lost flame, wrong flower or missed placement ends this episode. Solve only from screenshots and visible task controls. Do not use code, scripts, automation, Developer Tools, console/debugger/inspector/network/source/DOM/page-state inspection, terminal/shell/Python, address-bar or URL/query edits, reload/navigation, browser extensions, external applications, or hidden-state access. Use only the task tab and its visible controls.
